name: @equin/plugin-apps-chord-song-index
description: The Chord app's song index: TheoryTab sections read into sound tokens (root above the tonic, stacked intervals, inversion), spelling features, and 4-bar loop windows, loaded on first use from a compact snapshot of Sheet Sage's Hooktheory dump. An endpoint to open the index, a live loop find (chord.loops) over an unlocked chord set, loop counts, a live load status, and the snapshot's backup source.
